title: Photon Cut
description:
Deal 10 damage.
Draw 1 card.
Put 1 card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
upgraded_description:
Deal 13 damage.
Draw 2 cards.
Put 1 card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
notes: Player must select a card from their hand to place on top of the draw pile.
